description:
The US military has spent roughly $25 billion on the war with Iran since it began in late February, the Pentagon’s top financial officer told lawmakers on Wednesday. 

Most of that spending is on munitions, but some of it is on maintenance and replacing equipment, Jules “Jay” Hurst told the House Armed Services Committee. 

Former NATO Supreme Allied Commander Wesley Clark gives his reaction to the cost of Operation Epic Fury.  

Also, CNN senior reporter Zachary Cohen, CNN global affairs analyst Karim Sadjadpour, CNN national security analyst Beth Sanner and former Pentagon deputy press secretary Sabrina Singh weigh in on Pete Hegseth’s House Armed Services Committee testimony.

0:00 Ranking Democrat asks Pentagon official the price of the Iran war 
2:07 Retired general Wesley Clark explains the war’s price tag so far 
4:16 CNN national security analyst on the importance of the war lasting 60 days 
8:01 How is Iran thinking about the war? 

Watch more CNN here: https://cnn.it/4kh5RPe
title: Iran War has cost $25B so far; experts reveal more hidden costs to US
